title: Securing Reliability: A Brief Overview on Enhancing In-Context Learning for Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper is a survey of methods to enhance the reliability and trustworthiness of foundation models. It specifically includes a section on 'Group Debiasing' which discusses fairness and toxicity across demographic groups including religion. It also reviews methodologies related to 'harmlessness' and 'socio-technical trustworthiness', which are core components of AI ethics.
